content.title: US regulators approve SpaceX's Starmind satellite internet project
content.caption: The FCC gives SpaceX permission to launch a million satellites into space to build data centers.

slides.heading: US regulators approve SpaceX's Starmind satellite internet project
slides.text: The FCC gives SpaceX permission to launch a million satellites into space to build data centers.

slides.heading: What SpaceX wants to do
slides.text: SpaceX wants to use sunlight to power satellites that will process data for AI and send the results back to Earth.

slides.heading: Why it matters
slides.text: The FCC approval opens a bold new frontier for the computing infrastructure needed to power America's leadership and growth.
